title: 从材料到可信演示
subtitle: 把观点、证据、结构与视觉资产组织成一套可交付的演示系统
audience: 内容团队 / 策略团队 / 创意技术团队
tone: warm editorial paper + cinematic evidence + structured diagrams

assets.continuity: one quiet urban interior, neutral white balance, local warm practical lights, low saturation, deep black separation
assets.replacementRule: These bundled stills demonstrate the visual grammar. Replace them with subject-specific local assets when generating a real deck.
assets.fallback: In upload-slots mode, remove demonstration stills and use empty labeled .ecp-still--fallback upload wells. Never synthesize fake photography with CSS or SVG.

sourceSummary.thesis: 风格、结构和证据必须共同服务于理解，质量控制要把真实结果沉淀回模板。
keyArguments: 先构建语义中间层，再渲染页面
影像是证据与空间，不是装饰滤镜
多视角资产必须保持空间连续性
质量回归要区分叙事、美学、资产和运行层问题
